footer.tagline: Subscriptions at verified gyms, monthly plans with trainers, and the tools to run your own gym.

landing.title: Run your gym without the paperwork
landing.lead: Members, monthly fees, attendance, reminders, staff and workout plans in one place, on your phone. Members find you, buy passes online and show a QR code at the front desk.
landing.featuresLead: Built with gym owners in Dhaka: simple enough for the front desk, clear enough for the owner.

members.title: Members
members.body: Every member with their package, start date and phone, searchable in seconds.

fees.title: Monthly fees
fees.body: See who has paid and who is due. Online payments go through Kriraghor and reach you as payouts.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.body: Admit members at the front desk by QR code or a 6-character code, and see the day's visits.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.body: Members get a reminder before their package ends, so renewals don't slip.

staff.title: Staff
staff.body: Give your front desk staff only the desks they need: admissions, subscriptions sold, nothing else.

plans.title: Workout plans
plans.body: Trainers sell monthly plans; members follow them and pay each month on Kriraghor.

pricing.title: Pricing

start.title: Set up your gym on Kriraghor
start.lead: One Kriraghor account works everywhere. Start a private gym with just a verified phone, or apply to list your gym for members to find.

public.title: A gym members can find
public.body: A public gym page with photos, hours and subscriptions members buy online.
public.signInFirst: Sign in first (on the left), then apply here.

private.title: Private gym
private.body: Run your members, fees and check-ins without a public listing. A verified phone is all you need.

signIn.body: Sign in or create your account first. You'll come straight back here.

apply.body: Apply for the gym owner role. Next, send your documents for review on kriraghor.com.

privateFlow.admissionHint: Added to a member's first package (and after a re-join).
privateFlow.nextBody: Add photos and opening hours, then send your gym for review. You can bring in your members at any time.

upsell.askOwner: Ask the gym owner to change the plan.

attendance.title: Check-ins need a higher plan
attendance.body: Checking members in at the desk and with their QR is part of the paid plans. You can still find members and admit subscriptions bought online.

reminders.title: Reminders need a higher plan
reminders.body: Automatic renewal and due reminders are part of the paid plans.

online_fees.title: Online fees need a higher plan
online_fees.body: Members paying their fees online is part of the paid plans.

reports.title: Reports need a higher plan
reports.body: Reports, the monthly report and exports are part of the higher plans.

trainers.title: Trainers need a higher plan
trainers.body: Assigning trainers to members is part of the higher plans.

plans.title: Plans need a higher plan
plans.body: Workout plans and diet charts are part of the higher plans.

multi_gym.title: Several gyms need a higher plan
multi_gym.body: Seeing several gyms on one dashboard is part of the top plan.

expenses.title: Expenses need a paid plan
expenses.body: Recording expenses and closing the cash drawer are part of the paid plans.

lockers.title: Lockers need a paid plan
lockers.body: Renting lockers to members and tracking their fees are part of the paid plans.

pos.title: The counter shop needs a higher plan
pos.body: Selling supplements and gear at the counter, with stock and receipts, is part of the higher plans.

pnl.title: Profit and loss needs a higher plan
pnl.body: Income, costs and profit by month are part of the higher plans.

classes.title: Classes need a higher plan
classes.body: A class timetable with bookings and a waitlist is part of the higher plans.

points.title: Reward points need a higher plan
points.body: Points for visits and referrals, and rewards at the desk, are part of the higher plans.

notices.title: Notices need a higher plan
notices.body: Sending notices to groups of members is part of the higher plans.

leads.title: Enquiries need a paid plan
leads.body: People asking about your gym from its page is part of the paid plans.

staff_attendance.title: Staff attendance needs a higher plan
staff_attendance.body: Shifts, clocking in with the entrance QR and monthly hours are part of the higher plans.

equipment.title: The equipment register needs a higher plan
equipment.body: Machines, their service schedule and repairs are part of the higher plans.

payroll.title: Payroll needs a higher plan
payroll.body: Pay terms, commissions, the monthly payroll and payslips are part of the top plan.

visits.title: Free trial visits need a paid plan
visits.body: Let people book a free visit on your gym page and see today's guests at the desk.

progress.title: Body progress needs the Standard plan
progress.body: Members and trainers record weight and measurements and see the change over time.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp messages need a higher plan
whatsapp.body: Sending notices, greetings and receipts on WhatsApp is part of the higher plans.
